maya: Heads-up — PR #3421 updates SDK snippets for streaming + retries across py/ts/go. Need a quick docs review before merge. Key changes: Python streaming example adds exponential backoff for retrying partial streams; TS adds cursor-based pagination + stream pattern; Go example simplifies chunking. Also fixed a broken link in migrations.md -> /docs/migrations/sdk.md

chris: can you paste the new python snippet here? :eyes:

maya: sure, here's the essence (already in PR):
```python
# python streaming with retry/backoff
from redwood import Client, RetryPolicy
client = Client()
policy = RetryPolicy(backoff="expo", max_retries=3)
with client.stream("gpt-lite", retry_policy=policy, timeout=60) as s:
    for chunk in s:
        print(chunk.text)
```

raj: looks good. small nit: keep `timeout=60` as maya added — avoids hanging on slow upstreams. also suggest logging the retry count for telemetry.

leah: I'll update the TS example to show paginate+stream usage. planning to add this snippet:
```ts
// TS cursor + streaming example
import { RedwoodClient } from "@redwood/inference"
const c = new RedwoodClient()
for await (const page of c.paginate("chat.list", { pageSize: 50 })) {
  for (const item of page.items) {
    await c.stream(item.id, { onData: (d)=> console.log(d) })
  }
}
```

sam: quick coordination: assigning ownership — maya -> docs PR #3421 (merge block), leah -> #3422 (TS update). can we also add a short migration note about the stream iterator change? link suggestion: https://redwood.ai/docs/migrations/stream-iter (fixes broken link too)
